title: Document Request Notice
subject: 📄 Action Required: Missing Documents for Your {country} Application ({student_name})
body:
Dear {student_name},

Required Documents / Notes:
{notes}

title: Official Admission / Offer Issued
subject: 🎉 Congratulations! Official Offer Issued for {country} ({program_or_job})
body:
Dear {student_name},

We are delighted to inform you that your application for {country} ({program_or_job}) has been officially accepted!

Application Details:
• Target Country: {country}
• Program / Job Track: {program_or_job}
• Current Status: Offer Issued

Next Steps:
1. Log into your dashboard to review and download your official acceptance offer.
2. Complete tuition / processing fee confirmation as outlined.
3. Begin visa document preparation.

Advisor Notes:
{notes}

Best regards,
Study with Czech Bridge HQ (Brno, Czech Republic)

title: Work Permit / Visa Approval Notice (Malaysia ESD / Serbia NES)
subject: 🇲🇾🇷🇸 Work Permit Approved: {country} Employment Visa Clearance ({student_name})
body:
Dear {student_name},

Great news regarding your work permit / employment visa application for {country}!

Your work authorization clearance (Calling Visa / NES Approval) has been successfully issued by the Ministry authorities.

Summary:
• Candidate Name: {student_name}
• Destination Country: {country}
• Visa Track: Work Permit / Employment Pass
• Status: Approved & Cleared

Instructions:
1. Download your official Work Permit Approval Document from your student vault.
2. Complete your medical screening requirements as instructed.
3. Proceed with embassy single-entry / Type D visa endorsement.

Counselor Advice:
{notes}

Best regards,
Study with Czech Bridge Global Mobility Team

title: Embassy Visa Interview & File Prep Guide
subject: 🛂 Embassy Visa File Ready & Interview Preparation for {country}
body:
Dear {student_name},

Your long-term visa application packet for {country} is complete and ready for submission to the Embassy!

Embassy Submission Checklist:
1. Valid Passport (minimum 18 months validity)
2. Stamped Acceptance Letter / Work Permit Approval
3. Proof of Certified Accommodation & Bank Financial Proof
4. Sworn Translated & Super-legalized Documents

Interview Notes from Brno Team:
{notes}

Please review your step-by-step visa checklist in your portal dashboard.

Best regards,
Study with Czech Bridge Visa Operations
